exposure: indications for HDU admission (e.g., eclampsia, acute kidney injury, PPH)
patient demographics (age, booking status, past obstetric history, preexisting medical disorders)
outcome: maternal morbidity (recovery, discharge from HDU, transfer to CCU)
cohort: 485 obstetric patients admitted to the High Dependency Unit of a tertiary care hospital in Kolkata, India, over an 18-month period.
finding: Of 485 women admitted to the HDU, 85.36% recovered, 6.19% required a higher level of care, and 6.80% died, with eclampsia being the most common indication for admission.
mod_finding: Acute kidney injury following caesarean section accounted for 17.07% of the observed complications leading to HDU admission.
